stage: post-audit, pre-model: no model trained, no feature-target statistic computed

excluded_datasets.Deng2023: criterion 3: no license file in the GitHub repository; the article (not open access) states data are provided upon journal request only

Arita2018.reason: location maps built from outcome labels (IDH status); target leakage by construction

Granata2021.reason: clinical variable, not a radiomic feature

Wang2024.reason: first biopsy only, one row per patient

Hosny2018B.reason: IDs are patient IDs of the form LUNG1-xxx; one row per patient; one missing ID kept

Hunter2023.reason: 520 distinct patient prefixes, one nodule per patient

sensitivity_exclusion_set.reason: metadata reports missing values but the data has none; likely imputed on the full dataset before release. A pre-registered sensitivity analysis repeats the main comparisons without these datasets.

split_clusters.reason: possible patient overlap (BraTS 2021 includes UPenn and UCSF cases); the cluster is assigned to development or confirmation as one unit

removed.reason: removed after id_checks: 0 overlapping normalised IDs; grade II/III glioma vs newly diagnosed glioblastoma

known_limitations.Petrillo2023: the radMLBench curator chose the endpoint with the highest AUC in the source study, so absolute AUC may be optimistic; this affects all compared methods alike
known_limitations.Veeraraghavan2020: radMLBench metadata lists MRI/breast cancer, but the source study is contrast-enhanced CT in endometrial cancer; descriptive only
